test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Direction: Pick the odd one out from the given options.
solution:
**Concept Used: **Classification based on chemical composition

Here, **Charcoal, Diamond, and Graphite** are all forms (allotropes) of carbon.

Whereas, **Silver** is a metal element.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Property
 Analysis
 
 

 Silver
 Metal element
 It is a metal and not a form of carbon.
 
 

 Charcoal
 Form of carbon
 It is an amorphous form of carbon.
 
 

 Diamond
 Form of carbon
 It is a crystalline allotrope of carbon.
 
 

 Graphite
 Form of carbon
 It is a crystalline allotrope of carbon.
